name: Editorial Data
summary: A Swiss financial report come alive: hairline grid, giant mono numerals, one accent per frame and a circled −18%.
look: Warm paper with a visible 12-column hairline grid, 3 px ink rules, giant JetBrains Mono numerals, Instrument Serif headlines and letter-spaced mono labels; coral or teal as the single accent per frame.

components.name: Hairline grid
components.role: 12 columns of 80 px, 1.5 px lines at 7 % ink — always visible, never decorative

components.name: Masthead
components.role: mark + “ACME · PULSE REPORT” + issue number on a 3 px rule; the film reads as a publication

components.name: Hero numeral
components.role: JetBrains Mono 230–300 px, tight tracking; the number is the headline

components.name: Task strip
components.role: perforated vertical tape of chores scrolling in a loop; the active row takes the accent

components.name: Annotated chart
components.role: single ink line, dashed event rule, coral point with a leader line and margin note

components.name: Colophon close
components.role: double rule, centred lockup, three mono stats, one coral pill

motion.name: Mask rise
motion.how: headline blocks rise 100 % through a rule-aligned mask, power4.out 0.5 s, landing on the downbeat

motion.name: Counter tick
motion.how: numerals step once per beat (0.5 s at 120 BPM) with steps(1) — no tweening, like a split-second ledger

motion.name: Line draw + pin
motion.how: chart stroke-dashoffset 100 → 0 over one bar (2 s, linear); the anomaly numeral scales 1.08 → 1 in 0.2 s on the next downbeat

story: Hook: a looping strip of dashboard chores beside a counter that ticks to ×38 under the question. Reveal: “Acme / Pulse” sets as a typographic masthead between rules with Speed and Control columns. Proof: an annotated chart shows checkout conversion falling after deploy #2231 at 09:42, the −18% numeral lands in coral and the decision row offers Roll back. CTA: a colophon with the lockup, three stats and a coral Start free pill.
adapt: Choose the one number your product changes (time saved, errors caught, cost avoided) and make it the hero numeral; the chart simply shows the before/after around the moment your product intervenes.

references.note: FT Visual Vocabulary: newsroom chart grammar
Swiss Style grid and typographic principles

fit.risk: Can read as a static report; needs strict rhythm and one accent colour per frame.
